Welcome to Terma Coffee

Welcome to Terma Coffee — where every cup tells a story of Nepal's finest highlands. Nestled in the heart of Balaju-16, Kathmandu, Terma Coffee is not just a coffee shop; it is a celebration of Nepali coffee culture, craftsmanship, and community.

At Terma Coffee, we believe that great coffee should never come at a great price. That is why we are proud to offer A-grade quality coffee at the most affordable prices in Kathmandu — because everyone deserves to enjoy a truly exceptional cup, without emptying their wallet.

What makes Terma Coffee truly special is our roots. Our coffee is fully grown and carefully crafted in Nuwakot, one of Nepal's most fertile and beautiful regions. From the lush green hills of Nuwakot, our beans are cultivated with love, harvested at peak ripeness, and processed with traditional care to preserve every note of flavor. When you sip a cup of Terma Coffee, you are tasting the pure essence of Nepali soil, sun, and dedication.

We are a proudly local Nepali brand — from the farm to your cup, every step happens right here in Nepal. We support local farmers, local production, and local dreams.

Terma Coffee was founded by Sugam Pudasaini, a passionate entrepreneur with a vision to bring world-class Nepali coffee to the streets of Kathmandu and beyond. Sugam's mission is simple — to put Nepali coffee on the map and prove that Nepal can produce some of the finest coffee in all of Asia.

Come visit us at Balaju-16, Kathmandu. Whether you need a morning boost, an afternoon escape, or simply a warm and welcoming place to relax — Terma Coffee is your cup of Nepal.
